title: CI jobs near their time caps (checks-merge-install, checks-windows-rest, shell-macos) finish inside them, so no main run is cancelled
why: checks-merge-install hit its 30-minute cap and main's push run 43164094808 on f024eae4e was cancelled, so the merge tool reads main as UNKNOWN and every merge waits.
note: Stability fix. Lane started 01:01 CST Nov 12. Batch runner 10 re-runs the main run once meanwhile. Related: step ci-job-caps-line-count. Part landed: PR #2634 raised the checks-merge-install cap from 30 to 75 minutes, in batch 94 (7e7cd97a4, by 02:39 CST Nov 12). Widened (coordinator 02:39 CST): the same lane now takes checks-windows-rest, which runs 32 minutes of its 37-minute cap. The step stays open until that lands. Widened again (coordinator 04:08 CST Nov 12): the lane also takes the shell-macos cap, 30 minutes of its 40. #2653 (stopgap caps for macos-b, the windows-merge shards and shoot; round 3 PASS, net value zero) is with batch runner 10 for the next code batch (coordinator 06:53 CST Nov 12). Coordinator 00:10 CST Nov 14 (relayed): close with its proof or record the missing measure today. #2634 and #2653 merged; caps on main are shell-macos 75, windows-rest 60 per an agent read, unverified by the coordinator and by triage.
